# Catherine Pullen

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Catherine Pullen maintains a naturally optimistic personality, preferring to view situations in a positive light. She considers her optimistic nature a necessity of living alongside [Eliza](../character/eliza-pullen.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P21](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0021), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)_

## History

In her youth, Catherine Pullen did not spend her time gallivanting to public halls. During a canvassing effort for the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), she secretly went outside to donate two quarters to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde for their hall fund after her sister [Eliza](../character/eliza-pullen.md) bitterly refused to contribute.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P16](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0016), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P18](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0018), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)_
